item.title: Nvidia-Backed Firm Launches $3.1 Billion GPU Loan into Market
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The five-year loan, which funds the purchase of graphics processing units for Zankore’s new AI factory, will pay an interest margin of 330 basis points over the Secured Overnight Financing Rate, said the people, who asked not to be identified discussing private matters. Citigroup declined to comment, while UOB and Zankore didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment.
